questions.question: Which of the following is/are the policy instrument of Reserve Bank of India? I. Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) II. Reserve Deposit Ratio (RDR)
questions.questionHtml:
Which of the following is/are the policy instrument of Reserve Bank of India?
I. Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF)
II. Reserve Deposit Ratio (RDR)
questions.solution:
Both options listed are policy instruments used by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI):

I. Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF): This is a monetary policy tool that allows banks to borrow money through repurchase agreements (repos) to maintain liquidity. It helps manage short-term liquidity mismatches.

II. Reserve Deposit Ratio (RDR): This is more commonly referred to as the Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) or Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR), which are requirements that banks must hold a certain percentage of their deposits as reserves with the RBI.

Therefore, both I and II are indeed policy instruments of the Reserve Bank of India.

Dispersion occurs when light is separated into its component colors due to differences in wavelength. In the case of a CD, the grooves cause this dispersion, leading to the colorful patterns you see.

The reflection of light is the bouncing back of light rays when they hit a surface that does not absorb all of the light.
